name: Disc Remux
overview: Turn DVD rips (VIDEO_TS, split VOB imports) into one client-friendly MKV
description: Finds VIDEO_TS folders and single VTS_xx_x.VOB files imported by Radarr/Sonarr, joins the main title into one MKV without re-encoding the video, adds a stereo AAC default track and converts DVD bitmap subtitles to SRT with tesseract OCR.

versions.changelog:
- OCR: restore ♪ in song lines, universal language defaults, logo, full README
- Disc Remux 0.1.0: DVD rips to a single MKV for Jellyfin
